capabilities: Record microphone and system audio from the sidebar or import existing audio clips
Transcribe audio via any OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint such as vLLM Whisper or whisper.cpp
Summarize transcripts with a local LLM, optionally steered by vault context notes
Edit the summary, transcript, memo, title and tags in the sidebar before saving
Save a single note with frontmatter, anarlog-style summary and collapsible transcript callouts
disambiguation: Despite the nautical 'ship's gossip' name, it is not a chat or social tool; it records, transcribes and summarizes meetings.
extras: Desktop only, since recording uses the microphone. Installed from source rather than the community store; release builds have GitHub Actions provenance attestations. Explains a macOS limitation: system audio capture needs a loopback device such as BlackHole.
intentEvidence: A local-first meeting companion that lives in your Obsidian sidebar, inspired by anarlog.
problem: Turning meeting recordings into notes normally requires cloud transcription services or separate apps; Obsidian has no built-in record-transcribe-summarize workflow.
